scope: CPU encoding capacity under observed BC needs-ID changed-record delivery upper bounds

evidence_gates.release_transfer_and_deployment_io: UNVERIFIED, not measured in these inputs

encoding.rate_rule: Maximum per-host p95 chunk elapsed/photo, plus combined photo staging seconds divided by all 512 samples. Setup is budgeted separately.

policy.role: Legacy comparison, separate from time budget spillover policy
policy.overhead_warning: 600 seconds is an assumed budget for model, metadata, transfer and index work, not a measured production envelope

caveats: Added means entering the eligible pool, including re-entry, not necessarily a new observation or uncached photo.
Replaced means eligible records fetched again, including intentional two-hour overlap, edits unrelated to photos, and manual reruns.
Daily totals include manual dispatches and overlap duplicates, so they are conservative operational deliveries, not unique daily photo changes.
All-grade fetched totals and photo URL/content deltas are not logged; eligible added+replaced bounds cache checks/new embeddings needed for this pool, not all iNaturalist records fetched.
Only current map-state release exists; overwritten pool/sync assets cannot recover historical photo URL changes.
Needs-ID pool workload does not bound adding or refreshing Research Grade reference embeddings.
Fourteen daily observations cannot establish seasonal, annual, or future peak demand.
Counters are actual logged transitions over variable query intervals, not historical updated_since API reconstructions.
arrival_trace.scope: British Columbia needs-ID records with photos/coordinates; eligible changed-record deliveries, not photo changes

queue_model.kind: Modeled repeated observed 14-day trace, not an actual outage experiment or annual forecast
queue_model.recovery_rule: Recovery capacity when prior end-day backlog is positive; otherwise normal capacity

index_evidence.synthetic_warning: Balanced random PQ codes test capacity, not population recall or skew.
index_evidence.scaling_warning: Linear extrapolations on this benchmark's index, not measured daily runs; local I/O excludes release transfer and deployment

seasonality_evidence.interpretation: Retrospective seasonal planning envelope of currently visible photo observations by UTC creation day. Current quality/photo state and deletion bias; not observed historical arrivals, eligible changes, new photo attachments to old observations, or reference-refresh work.
seasonality_evidence.boundary_validation: Date-only created_d2 included an extra day; corrected using explicit UTC date-times. created_on uses a different day boundary, so count checks also use explicit UTC times.

seasonality_note: Retrospective planning envelope only. No annual capacity gate inferred by this analyzer
